# Vendored: Cindy plugin manifest validator

`plugin-manifest.bcdea7e27f97.mjs` and `NOTICE` are copied unmodified from
[makecindy/cindy-official-plugins](https://github.com/makecindy/cindy-official-plugins) at commit
`4223c43e440d2c695b6ad649b9a4d97b22a7cf4c`, path `tests/contracts/`. That file is generated from Cindy's
`packages/plugin-protocol/src/manifest.ts` (its header names the Cindy base commit and the source sha256) and is the
`validateGhostManifest` the official plugin repository pins for its CI gate.

used only by `test/test_market_contract.mjs` and is not part of the plugin package.
